author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt McLain dealing with calf injury
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Matt McLain's calf is a little beat up.
impact: McLain is day-to-day heading into the final weekend before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carson Whisenhunt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Giants recalled LHP Carson Whisenhunt from Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Whisenhunt will start in Thursday's game against the Rockies. He'll be tough to trust for fantasy managers, though the matchup is favorable on paper.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Walker optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Giants optioned RHP Ryan Walker to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Walker's struggles continued into his appearance on Wednesday where he allowed back-to-back home runs. He'll look to work on some things in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sonny Gray drawing trade interest from Braves
desc: The Braves have expressed interest in Red Sox RHP Sonny Gray.
impact: The Astros have also been linked to Gray. If the Red Sox decide to sell, he'll be one of the top starters moved at this year's deadline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk (shin) activated from IL
desc: The Marlins activated RHP Janson Junk from the 15-day injured list.
impact: Junk makes his return for Thursday's series finale against the Mariners. He has posted a 4.80 ERA in 11 starts this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John King (ankle) placed on IL
desc: The Marlins placed LHP John King on the 15-day injured list with a left lateral ankle sprain.
impact: King had been pitching well in the bullpen for Miami. He will be sidelined for at least the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Brzykcy optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Marlins optioned RHP Zach Brzykcy to Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Brzykcy will continue to move up and down throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Gusto recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Marlins recalled RHP Ryan Gusto from Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Gusto could return in a long relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Willson Contreras to begin serving five-game suspension Thursday
desc: Willson Contreras will begin serving his five-game suspension on Thursday.
impact: Contreras had his suspension reduced from seven games to five games. He can return to Boston's lineup for the second game of the doubleheader coming out of the All-Star break on July 17.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mark Vientos exits early Thursday
desc: Mark Vientos was removed from Thursday's game after getting hit on his right hand.
impact: Vientos will head to be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Littell to pitch in bulk relief role Friday
desc: Zack Littell will pitch in a bulk relief role on Friday against the Yankees.
impact: Carson Palmquist will serve as the opener for Washington. Littell will follow him on the mound in Friday's series opener.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carson Palmquist to serve as opener Friday
desc: Carson Palmquist will open for the Nationals on Friday against the Yankees.
impact: Palmquist will open the game before Zack Littell takes over in a bulk relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) expected to return Friday
desc: Munetaka Murakami is expected to be back in the White Sox lineup on Friday.
impact: Murakami has played in a pair of rehab games this week. He has been on the injured list since late May.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Lou Trivino (back) placed on 15-day IL
desc: The Phillies have placed right-hander Lou Trivino (back) on the 15-day injured list due to a right thoracic muscle spasm.
impact: Trivino struggled in his two most recent outings and will get some time off to deal with his back issue. The veteran has made just five appearances for the Phillies this season, and is without a timetable to return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mike Trout goes yard in return to lineup against Rangers
desc: Mike Trout went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rangers with a home run, two runs scored, two RBI, and one walk.
impact: Trout picked up right where he left off in the lineup, recording a hit in his ninth consecutive contest. The superstar outfielder remains one of the few explosive options in the Angels lineup when healthy for manager Kurt Suzuki, carrying an .874 OPS with 18 homers, 38 RBI, 56 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 75 games.
